name: Bonanza
description: Bonanza seller API (Bonapitit) for the US marketplace: orders, shipping and tracking, offers, buyer feedback, booth items with price and quantity updates, categories and traits, booth statistics and buyer messages. Dev id, cert id and user token.
instructions:
## Bonanza
This connector works with **Bonapitit**, the Bonanza API (`https://api.bonanza.com/api_requests/secure_request`), for sellers on Bonanza, the US marketplace for independent sellers: orders, shipping and tracking, offers, feedback, booth items with price and quantity, categories and traits, booth statistics and buyer messages.

**Setup (1 to 2 business days, then 5 minutes)**
1. Apply for an API account at https://api.bonanza.com/accounts/new. Bonanza approves applications by email, usually within 1 to 2 business days; the welcome email and the Bonapitit dashboard show your **dev id** and **cert id**. Paste them into `BONANZA_DEV_ID` and `BONANZA_CERT_ID`.
2. Get a user token for your seller account: send a fetchToken request, for example `curl -X POST https://api.bonanza.com/api_requests/secure_request -H 'X-BONANZLE-API-DEV-NAME: <dev id>' -H 'X-BONANZLE-API-CERT-NAME: <cert id>' -d fetchTokenRequest`. The answer holds `authToken` and `authenticationURL`.
3. Open the authenticationURL, log in with the Bonanza seller account and approve. Paste the authToken into `BONANZA_USER_TOKEN`.

User tokens expire one year after they were fetched, or when the seller deactivates them in the Bonanza account. `bonanza_fetch_token` starts a new one from the chat; `bonanza_get_token_status` shows the expiry.

**Where to start**: `bonanza_get_user` returns the seller's user name, which is also the booth id. `bonanza_list_orders` with order_status Completed lists paid orders that still have to ship.

**Orders**: `bonanza_list_orders`, `bonanza_get_orders`. Ship with `bonanza_mark_order_shipped` (tracking number, carrier usps, ups, fedex or other). Offers (status Proposed): `bonanza_accept_offer`, `bonanza_deny_offer`. Feedback for the buyer: `bonanza_leave_feedback`. Bonanza has no API for refunds or cancellations; the connector never moves money.

**Items**: `bonanza_list_booth_items` (by status: for_sale, ready_to_post, missing_fields, reserved, sold), `bonanza_get_item`, `bonanza_add_item`, `bonanza_revise_item`, and `bonanza_update_inventory` for price and quantity of many items at once (not for items with variations). `bonanza_end_items` removes items and is installed switched off. Categories and traits: `bonanza_get_categories` (0 for the top level), `bonanza_get_category_traits`.

**Booth and messages**: `bonanza_get_booth`, `bonanza_get_booth_stats`, `bonanza_list_message_threads`, `bonanza_get_messages`, `bonanza_send_message`, `bonanza_update_message`.

**How calls look**: every call is a POST whose JSON body is wrapped in the call name, for example `getOrdersRequest`; the answer has `ack` (Success, Warning or Failure) and the result under `getOrdersResponse`. The connector adds the user token as requesterCredentials. Errors carry `errorMessage` with a `type` such as `Bonapitit::AccountNotFound` (wrong dev or cert id), `InvalidAuthToken` or `TokenNotVerified` (token wrong or not approved yet), and come back with HTTP 500 or 200.

**Formats and limits**: prices are US dollars; times are ISO 8601 in GMT. Order lists page with entries_per_page (up to 100) and page_number (up to 100 pages). Rapid repeated calls can be throttled (RequestsThrottled), and an account has daily caps on calls (TooManyRequests) and on errors (TooManyErrors).

BONANZA_DEV_ID.label: Dev id
BONANZA_DEV_ID.help: From the Bonapitit welcome email or dashboard after Bonanza approved your API account (apply at api.bonanza.com/accounts/new).
BONANZA_DEV_ID.patternMessage: Paste the dev id without spaces.

BONANZA_CERT_ID.label: Cert id
BONANZA_CERT_ID.help: The certificate id next to the dev id in the Bonapitit welcome email or dashboard.
BONANZA_CERT_ID.patternMessage: Paste the cert id without spaces.

BONANZA_USER_TOKEN.label: User token
BONANZA_USER_TOKEN.help: authToken from a fetchToken request, approved by logging in at its authenticationURL with the seller account. Valid for one year.

verifyHints.401: Bonanza did not accept the user token: it is wrong, expired (one year) or was never approved at its authenticationURL. Fetch a new token and approve it with the seller account.
verifyHints.403: Bonanza refused the call for this account. Check that the API account is approved and that the token belongs to the seller who owns the item or order.
verifyHints.404: Bonanza found no order, item or booth with that id.
verifyHints.500: Bonanza answered with an error. Bonapitit::AccountNotFound means the dev id or cert id is wrong; InvalidAuthToken or TokenNotVerified mean the user token is wrong or not approved yet.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Bonanza throttled the calls (RequestsThrottled) or the daily cap is reached (TooManyRequests). Slow down and try again later.

prerequisites: A Bonanza seller account and an approved Bonapitit API account (apply at api.bonanza.com, approval usually within 1 to 2 business days) for the dev id and cert id, plus a user token the seller approves once a year. About 5 minutes after approval.

tools.name: bonanza_get_token_status
tools.description: Status of the user token: whether it is verified, when it expires (one year after it was fetched) and which user it belongs to. Use it to check the connection.

tools.name: bonanza_get_user
tools.description: The seller behind the token: userID, userName, email, feedback score and positive percentage, good standing, registration address and sellerInfo (storeOwner, storeURL). The user name is the booth id for bonanza_list_booth_items.

tools.name: bonanza_fetch_token
tools.description: Start a new user token (needed once a year, or after the seller deactivated it): returns authToken, authenticationURL and hardExpirationTime. The seller opens the authenticationURL and logs in to approve; then paste the authToken into BONANZA_USER_TOKEN.

validation_complete_url.description: Optional page the seller is offered after approving.

tools.name: bonanza_list_orders
tools.description: List the seller's orders: orderID, orderStatus (Completed = paid but not shipped, Shipped, Cancelled, InProcess, Invoiced, Proposed, Active, Incomplete), amountPaid, buyerUserName, buyerCheckoutMessage, createdTime, paidTime, itemArray (itemID, title, quantity, price, sellerInventoryID, variations), shippingAddress and shippingDetails. Filter by status and by created, modified or sold time. Up to 100 per page, at most 100 pages; hasMoreOrders says whether more follow.

order_status.description: Only this status; Completed means paid and waiting to ship.

created_from.description: Created at or after. ISO 8601 date-time in GMT, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z.

created_to.description: Created at or before. ISO 8601 date-time in GMT, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z.

modified_from.description: Modified at or after. ISO 8601 date-time in GMT, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z.

modified_to.description: Modified at or before. ISO 8601 date-time in GMT, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z.

sold_from.description: Sold at or after. ISO 8601 date-time in GMT, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z.

sold_to.description: Sold at or before. ISO 8601 date-time in GMT, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z.

tools.name: bonanza_get_orders
tools.description: Read specific orders by id with items, buyer, shipping address, amounts and status. Date filters do not apply here.

tools.name: bonanza_mark_order_shipped
tools.description: Mark an order shipped and add the tracking number and carrier, with an optional note to the buyer and a private note. Uses completeSale with the order id as transactionID.

tools.name: bonanza_accept_offer
tools.description: Accept a buyer's pending offer (order status Proposed). Accepting commits you to sell at the offered price.

tools.name: bonanza_deny_offer
tools.description: Deny a buyer's pending offer (order status Proposed) with completeSale deny; the item stays unsold.

tools.name: bonanza_leave_feedback
tools.description: Leave feedback for the buyer of an order: positive, neutral or negative with a comment of up to 250 characters.

target_user.description: User name or id of the buyer.

tools.name: bonanza_list_booth_items
tools.description: Items in the seller's booth by status: itemID, title, currentPrice (USD), quantity, sellingState, sku, category, pictures, item specifics and listing URL. Statuses other than for_sale need the user token, which the connector sends. Up to 500 per page.

booth_id.description: Booth id: the seller's user name from bonanza_get_user, or the booth's URL identifier.

sort.description: newest sorts newest first; leave out for Bonanza's default order.

tools.name: bonanza_get_item
tools.description: One of the seller's items by id, including data only the seller sees (getUnlistedItem): title, description, price, quantity, sellingState, item specifics, variations, pictures, shipping and return policy.

tools.name: bonanza_add_item
tools.description: List a new fixed price item in the seller's booth: title, description, price (USD), quantity, category, pictures, traits, shipping, return policy and variations. Returns itemId, categoryId and sellingState; booths with more than 40,000 items queue the request.

title.description: Item title (a title identical to another item in the booth is refused as a duplicate).

description.description: Description; most HTML is allowed, up to 60,000 characters.

quantity.description: Quantity for sale; 0 puts the item into Missing required fields.

primary_category.description: Category as an object with categoryId; Bonanza guesses one when left out.

pictureURL.description: Up to 4 public image URLs; Bonanza downloads them.

picture_details.description: Pictures: pictureURL list (up to 4) and optionally discardOld.

specifics.description: Label and value pairs, e.g. condition new, brand Acme.

item_specifics.description: Traits (see bonanza_get_category_traits): specifics as label and value pairs, optionally discardOld.

allow_for_sale.description: true sets the item active for sale right away (default false: ready to post).

accept_offers.description: false refuses best offers (Bonanza default true).

shipping_details.description: Bonanza shippingDetails object, e.g. shippingServiceOptions with shippingType Free, Flat (with shippingServiceCost) or Calculated (with calculatedShippingRate), and shipsWithinDays.

return_policy.description: Bonanza returnPolicy object: returnsAcceptedOption (ReturnsAccepted or ReturnsNotAccepted), returnsWithinOption (days), shippingCostPaidByOption (buyer or seller), description.

variations.description: Variations: quantity, price and nameValueList (name and value pairs, at most two names), optionally sku.

tools.name: bonanza_revise_item
tools.description: Change an existing item: any of title, description, price, quantity, category, pictures, traits, shipping, return policy or variations. Fields left out stay unchanged; discard_old_variations replaces all variations.

title.description: Item title (a title identical to another item in the booth is refused as a duplicate).

description.description: Description; most HTML is allowed, up to 60,000 characters.

quantity.description: Quantity for sale; 0 puts the item into Missing required fields.

primary_category.description: Category as an object with categoryId; Bonanza guesses one when left out.

pictureURL.description: Up to 4 public image URLs; Bonanza downloads them.

picture_details.description: Pictures: pictureURL list (up to 4) and optionally discardOld.

specifics.description: Label and value pairs, e.g. condition new, brand Acme.

item_specifics.description: Traits (see bonanza_get_category_traits): specifics as label and value pairs, optionally discardOld.

allow_for_sale.description: true sets the item active for sale right away (default false: ready to post).

accept_offers.description: false refuses best offers (Bonanza default true).

shipping_details.description: Bonanza shippingDetails object, e.g. shippingServiceOptions with shippingType Free, Flat (with shippingServiceCost) or Calculated (with calculatedShippingRate), and shipsWithinDays.

return_policy.description: Bonanza returnPolicy object: returnsAcceptedOption (ReturnsAccepted or ReturnsNotAccepted), returnsWithinOption (days), shippingCostPaidByOption (buyer or seller), description.

variations.description: Variations: quantity, price and nameValueList (name and value pairs, at most two names), optionally sku.

discard_old_variations.description: true drops existing variations before adding the given ones.

tools.name: bonanza_update_inventory
tools.description: Update price and quantity of many items in one call, keyed by item id. Up to 99 items are updated at once and answer per item; more are queued. Items with variations are not supported (use bonanza_revise_item).

quantity.description: New quantity; 0 puts the item into Missing required fields.

updates.description: Map of item id to the new values, e.g. item id 123456 with price 19.99 and quantity 3.

tools.name: bonanza_end_items
tools.description: Remove up to 100 items from the booth (endFixedPriceItem). Returns the number removed. Installed switched off.

tools.name: bonanza_get_booth
tools.description: Public booth information: name, description, policies, logo, activated, onVacation, custom categories and URL.

booth_id.description: Booth id: the seller's user name or the booth's URL identifier.

tools.name: bonanza_get_booth_stats
tools.description: Per-day statistics of the seller's booth for up to 60 trailing days: item views, booth views, sold offers and revenue per day.

human_only.description: true leaves bots and the seller's own views out of the view counts.

tools.name: bonanza_get_categories
tools.description: Child categories of a category (0 for the top level): categoryId, categoryName, leafCategory, traitCount. Use a leaf id as category_id.

parent_category_id.description: Parent category id; 0 for the top level.

tools.name: bonanza_get_category_traits
tools.description: Item traits of a category (for example Condition, Brand, Size) with their allowed values, to fill item_specifics.

tools.name: bonanza_list_message_threads
tools.description: Message threads of the seller (one per back-and-forth with a user): first message, latest message, read and saved state. Up to 200 per page.

read.description: true: only fully read threads; false: threads with an unread message.

saved.description: true: only saved threads; false: threads with an unsaved message.

tools.name: bonanza_get_messages
tools.description: All messages of the thread that contains a message id: id, from, to, sentAt, subject, body (may contain HTML), read, saved.

message_id.description: Any message id of the thread.

tools.name: bonanza_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a user, or reply to a message (reply_to). A new thread needs to and subject.

to.description: User name to write to; not needed with reply_to.

subject.description: Subject; not needed for a reply.

tools.name: bonanza_update_message
tools.description: Mark a message and its thread as read, or set the thread saved or unsaved (unsaved threads show in the inbox).

read.description: true marks the thread read (cannot be set back to unread).
